title: Geisha and Dragonflies
description: A woman in a colorful kimono holds a red paper umbrella while standing on a grassy path at night. She is surrounded by oversized, ornate dragonflies, glowing chrysanthemums, a lit traditional house, and a starry sky with a full moon.
prompt: A beautiful Japanese woman in a vibrant floral kimono stands on a grassy path holding a red umbrella at night. She is surrounded by giant, intricately decorated dragonflies with glowing wings. In the background is a traditional wooden house with lit windows, red chrysanthemums, a full moon, and a starry Milky Way sky. Magical atmosphere, detailed fantasy illustration.
